act_descr: Act 1: Ishita escapes burnout to Paris and stumbles into a citywide, improvised cinema-sound project that rekindles her creative pulse.
chapters: “Code that breathes, not optimizes.” We mapped a first route—Square Marcel-Bleustein-Blanchet overlook for tests, Montmartre’s steps for the first pop-up.
“Your bug is fear. Patch with wonder.”

act_descr: Act 3: A storm-swept Fête de la Musique forces a choice—plans or wonder—and turns the citywide experiment into a love letter written in light and sound.
chapters: I’d been optimizing out feelings; Paris reintroduced latency. We launched a twilight test across the Seine; lightning laced our cues into gold.
“We didn’t make a plan. We made a place to fall in love.”
